content.title: XO, Kitty Season 3: Release Date, Cast, Photos, Plot, Trailer, Soundtrack
content.text: Roses are red. Violets are blue. There’s a third season of XO, Kitty in store for you, and it’s streaming now! This spring, Kitty Song Covey (Anna Cathcart) returns to the Korean Independent School of Seoul (KISS) for her senior year, excited to check off everything on her Senior Sunset list. Catch up with Kitty and her classmates in some new photos from the upcoming season, below. And learn all about the Covey sisters’ reunion in this behind-the-scenes featurette now! To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before heroine Lara Jean (Lana Condor) appears in multiple episodes of the new season. Is it just us, or did you also feel chills the second LJ says, “Hi, sister,” in the trailer?Pardon the InterruptionThis title currently isn't available. XO, Tudum!What happens in XO, Kitty Season 3?Kitty returns for her final year at KISS with her perfect senior year mapped out. She’s going to make meaningful memories with her friends, grow closer to her relatives in Korea, and make big decisions about her future. And, she’s going to define her relationship with Min Ho (Sang Heon Lee). For real this time. But when surprise revelations derail her plans and relationships, Kitty will have to learn to embrace the unexpected.Check out some behind-the-scenes footage from the upcoming season below.Pardon the InterruptionThis title currently isn't available. You'll find lots to explore on the homepage.Error code: M7701-1003That’s a wrap on Season 3!Who are the new cast members joining XO, Kitty Season 3?Three new cast members are joining XO, Kitty Season 3:Sule Thelwell (Saint X) will play Marius Soy Kim (Like a French Film, Sorry Not Sorry) will play Yisoo Christine Hwang (Law and Order: SVU) will play GigiMeanwhile, Hojo Shin, who plays Kitty’s cousin, Jiwon, has been upped to a series regular.Which cast members are returning for XO, Kitty Season 3?Returning cast members include Anna Cathcart (Kitty Song Covey), Minyeong Choi (Dae), Gia Kim (Yuri), Sang Heon Lee (Min Ho), Anthony Keyvan (Q), Regan Aliyah (Juliana), Hojo Shin (Jiwon), Peter Thurnwald (Alex), Joshua Lee (Jin), Sasha Bhasin (Praveena), Michael K. Lee (Professor Lee), Philippe Lee (Mr. Moon), Jocelyn Shelfo (Madison), Han Bi Ryu (Eunice), and Sunny Oh (Mihee).Related StoriesWhat happened in XO, Kitty Season 2?Season 2 ended with Kitty getting her scholarship renewed so she can come back to KISS for senior year. She also fulfilled her late mother’s wishes by reuniting her fractured family, discovering relatives she never even knew existed. And, much to her surprise, this teen matchmaker fell for her ex-boyfriend’s best friend, Min Ho, ticking off almost every trope on the rom-com checklist as they went from enemies to friends to could-be lovers. Though their slow-burn romance is still simmering, Kitty asks Min Ho to wait before they part ways for the summer.See a video of Cathcart below holding the script for the first episode of the upcoming third season.XO, Kitty Season 2 premiered on Jan. 16, 2025 and debuted at No. 2 on the English TV List with 14.2 million views. The young adult romantic comedy, produced by Awesomeness Studios and ACE Entertainment, appeared in the Top 10 in 89 countries in its first week. The release also inspired viewers to revisit Season 1 (which resurfaced on the English TV List at No. 6 with 3.1 million views) and the original 2018 To All the Boys film the week after Season 2’s release (which reappeared at No. 6 on the English films list with 3.1 million views). What songs are on the XO, Kitty Season 3 soundtrack?Update your favorite playlists with the music of Season 3 of XO, Kitty now. This season features two original songs. The first is Eunice’s debut single, “Euniq,” which you first hear in Episode 3. Showrunner Valentina Garza tells Tudum the XO, Kitty team wanted Eunice’s single to have this “Jennie from BLACKPINK baddie energy as she debuts in this world of K-pop.” While Eunice might exude confidence on the track, there’s much more bubbling below her pop-star exterior. “[The song] is really in contrast with how she’s actually feeling. Because she’s actually not feeling that strong,” Garza explains. “It allows us to hold tension and was really exciting to write for Eunice.”The second single is “By My Side,” which is the song Min Ho writes to tell Kitty how he feels in the finale. the creative team behind XO, Kitty Season 3?As most XO, Kitty fans know, the series is a spin-off inspired by the popular To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before film franchise, which was based on creator and executive producer Jenny Han’s novels of the same name. For Season 3, Garza serves as showrunner, executive producer, and writer. Executive producers also include Matt Kaplan of ACE Entertainment and Bradley Gardner.What is the XO, Kitty Season 3 release date?See what all the KISS lovebirds are up to in Season 3, which is now streaming.
